I am inquiring about a reported fact. Is the Department of Homeland Security planning several new pilot projects in the field of something other than cybersecurity? Please answer with Yes, No, or Unknown.

rejected_documents.reason: Two direct contrasts are new versus old projects and cybersecurity versus another field. The December-15 No is not accepted: a September-15 publication dateline does not rule out continuing activity in December. Positive headless is-actively-planning questions lack a subject, and agency-involvement questions lack supporting evidence.

limits: Source grounding is not human gold, independent final evaluation, or proof of a valid/effective IA mechanism.
No labels were repaired. Unsupported, malformed, answer-tagged, copied-source repetitive and redundant candidates were not rewritten to fill shortages.
Explicit closed-text absence questions are distinguished from absence of a real-world event. Unknown references express source insufficiency; they are not Yes/No-stratum replacements.
Distinct slots may share source spans or contain overlap; notes disclose trial/death, visitor-role/country and other overlap. They are not claimed statistically independent.
Answer-in-query flags identify wording that already supplies the tested answer, beyond ordinary presentation of a candidate yes/no proposition. Partial contextual cues are discussed in notes.
All stored queries and references are exact existing packet values. Selected propositions are review annotations, not replacement online queries.
